daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is pushing you to think deeper than usual. Your ruling planet wants you to slow down and actually *feel* what you're processing instead of just collecting information like usual.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is bringing easy warmth to your connections. If you've been keeping things surface-level, today's a good day to let someone see a little more of what's really going on with you.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is creating serious momentum energy, but the Sun square Mars aspect might make you want to rush. Take the confidence boost but double-check details before moving forward on anything major.
daily.health: With Saturn retrograde in Aries, your nervous system might feel a bit wound up. Slow breathing or gentle movement could help more than your usual high-energy fixes today.

Mars-Jupiter aspects want you active; channel restless energy into movement you actually enjoy, not obligation-based workouts. Sleep matters this week; prioritize it around the Full Moon. Hydrate more than usual.
